title: Coot : model-building tools for molecular graphics

venue.name: Acta Crystallographica Section D Biological Crystallography

abstract: CCP4mg is a project that aims to provide a general-purpose tool for structural biologists, providing tools for X-ray structure solution, structure comparison and analysis, and publication-quality graphics. The map-fitting tools are available as a stand-alone package, distributed as 'Coot'.

Coot : model-building tools for molecular graphics (2004) in Acta Crystallographica Section D Biological Crystallography is authored by Paul Emsley and Kevin Cowtan. Topics: Graphics, R package, Computer science, Computer graphics (images) and Molecular graphics.

31752 citations (OpenAlex). Citations peaked in 2024 with 1871 citing works. Citing venues include bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory), Journal of Biological Chemistry and Nature Communications.
